name: omaTrail
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: omaTrail opens a frontier survival game from an Omarchy bar button onto a fullscreen trail map for keyboard and mouse. Name your party, buy supplies, set pace and rations, cross rivers, survive illness, trade at forts, and hunt wildlife. Switch between green-and-black Green Monitor graphics and Color Deluxe pixel art without changing rules or saves. It runs offline with no network, telemetry, account, daemon, or elevated access. It writes one bounded save and keeps the prior good save as backup.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: Choose green-and-black phosphor graphics or the original limited-color pixel palette. Gameplay and saves are identical.

schema.label: Difficulty
schema.description: Adjust travel pressure, river risk, hunting time, and animal movement speed.

schema.label: Reduced motion
schema.description: Reduce presentation animation without changing simulation timing or game outcomes.

schema.label: Hunting aim assist
schema.description: Widen hunting targets, slow animal movement, and extend the hunting timer.
